Test Case Title: Save a complete valid Financial Rules configuration and continue to Eligibility Criteria
Objective / Description: Happy path across all five tabs: a fully valid configuration enables Save & Continue and moves the wizard to Step 4.
Preconditions:
1. User is logged in with permission to edit loan product configuration.
2. A draft loan product exists with Step 1 General Information completed.
3. User opens /loan-product-config/edit/{productId} and selects Step 3 Financial Rules.
Test Data: Valid baseline: Interest Rate 25, Interest Type Flat; Admin fee on, 'From loan amount (principal)', Percentage 2 (valid under every candidate maximum), Collection Timing Upfront cash; Fee #1 Application fees Fixed 100; Disbursement Methods: first available option; Processing Days 2; Late Fee on, Percentage 5, One Time, Late Maximum Days 90; Late Installment Rule on, Minimum Percentage 50, By Deposit; Allow Partial Payment on, 50; Allow Early Settlement on, Early Percentage 5, Available after 6; Rounding Direction Round Nearest, Last Installment.
Test Steps:
1. Interest Rate tab: enter Interest Rate = 25 and keep Interest Type = Flat.
2. Fees tab: keep Admin fee on, select 'From loan amount (principal)', enter Percentage = 2, Collection Timing = Upfront cash.
3. Fees list: keep only Fee #1 (Application fees, Fixed, Fee Value 100); remove the others.
4. Disbursement Rules tab: select one Disbursement Method; Processing Days = 2.
5. Collection Rules tab: enter the baseline values for Late Fee, Late Installment Rule, Allow Partial Payment and Allow Early Settlement.
6. Rounding tab: keep Round Nearest and Last Installment.
7. Observe Save & Continue.
8. Click Save & Continue.
9. Observe the stepper and header.
Expected Result:
1. [Step 7] Save & Continue is enabled.
2. [Step 8] Step 4 Eligibility Criteria opens; no validation message is shown.
3. [Step 9] Step 3 Financial Rules no longer shows 'In Progress'; header percentage increases (observed 14% with 1 of 7 steps completed, S1).

Test Case Title: Persist all Financial Rules values after save, reload and re-login
Objective / Description: One data-integrity pass over all five tabs replaces 15 field-by-field persistence and edit cases.
Preconditions:
1. User is logged in with permission to edit loan product configuration.
2. A draft loan product exists with Step 1 General Information completed.
3. User opens /loan-product-config/edit/{productId} and selects Step 3 Financial Rules.
4. FR-NEW-001 has been executed for this product.
Test Data: Valid baseline: Interest Rate 25, Interest Type Flat; Admin fee on, 'From loan amount (principal)', Percentage 2, Collection Timing Upfront cash; Fee #1 Application fees Fixed 100; Disbursement Methods: first available option; Processing Days 2; Late Fee on, Percentage 5, One Time, Late Maximum Days 90; Late Installment Rule on, Minimum Percentage 50, By Deposit; Allow Partial Payment on, 50; Allow Early Settlement on, Early Percentage 5, Available after 6; Rounding Direction Round Nearest, Last Installment. Edit pass: Interest Rate 25 -> 15; Interest Type -> Decreasing; Collection Timing -> another option; Starting Bucket 31-60 -> 61-90; First Installment Status -> Waived; First Installment Due -> Days After Purchase 30.
Test Steps:
1. Reload the page and open each of the five tabs.
2. Compare every value with the baseline.
3. Apply the edit-pass values and click Save & Continue.
4. Log out, log in, reopen Step 3 and compare every tab.
Expected Result:
1. [Step 2] All values, toggles, radios, checkboxes, allocation order and fee rows equal the baseline.
2. [Step 3] Save succeeds; Step 4 opens.
3. [Step 4] Edited values are shown; all other values are unchanged.

Test Case Title: Keep Save & Continue disabled while any required Financial Rules field is empty

3. [Step 4] Same result for every listed field.
4. [Step 5] Fields of a toggled-off section do not block Save & Continue.

Preconditions:
1. User is logged in with permission to edit loan product configuration.
2. A draft loan product exists with Step 1 General Information completed.
3. User opens /loan-product-config/edit/{productId} and selects Step 3 Financial Rules.
Test Steps:
1. Read Collection Rules action labels.
2. Read Rounding labels.
3. Read Admin fee helper text.
4. Read the change banner.
Expected Result:
1. [Step 1] 'Right Off' reads 'Write Off' per approved copy (G-17).
2. [Step 2] 'Ballon payment rounding' reads 'Balloon'.
3. [Step 3] 'principle' reads 'principal' per approved copy.
4. [Step 4] Banner has no stray ', -' before 'not yet submitted'.

Test Case Title: Fee method switches between fixed EGP amount and percentage
Objective / Description: [Financial Rules] Verify Fixed and Percentage fee methods and invalid fee values.
Requirement ID: Screen: Step 3 Financial Rules (UI-derived, no written AC); FR-UI-06
Preconditions:
1. User is logged in with permission to edit loan product configuration.
2. A loan product exists in draft with Step 1 General Information and Step 2 Loan Structure completed.
3. User opens /loan-product-config/edit/{productId} and selects Step 3 Financial Rules.
Test Steps:
1. On Fee #1 with Fixed selected, read the placeholder.
2. Enter 150.50, then -10, then abc.
3. Select Percentage and read the placeholder.
4. Enter 101.
5. Switch back to Fixed.
Expected Result:
1. Fixed shows 'Enter fixed amount in EGP'.
2. 150.50 follows the decimal rule (GAP-34); -10 and abc are rejected.
3. Percentage shows a percentage input.
4. 101 is rejected or follows the confirmed percentage limit (GAP-34).
5. Switching method does not keep a value that is invalid for the new method.

Test Case Title: Processing Days and Notes validation
Objective / Description: [Financial Rules] Verify Processing Days input rules and that Notes is optional.
Requirement ID: Screen: Step 3 Financial Rules (UI-derived, no written AC); FR-UI-07
Preconditions:
1. User is logged in with permission to edit loan product configuration.
2. A loan product exists in draft with Step 1 General Information and Step 2 Loan Structure completed.
3. User opens /loan-product-config/edit/{productId} and selects Step 3 Financial Rules.
Test Data: Processing Days: '', -1, 1.5, abc, 0, 2. Notes: 500 chars incl. 'ملاحظة'.
Test Steps:
1. Leave Processing Days empty.
2. Enter -1, 1.5 and abc.
3. Enter 0, then 2.
4. Leave Notes empty and save; then enter a 500-character note with Arabic text and save.

1. Empty, negative, decimal and letter values are rejected or block Save & Continue.
2. 2 is accepted; 0 follows the confirmed rule (GAP-35).
3. Notes is optional; the long Arabic note reloads unchanged or is limited with a visible message.

Test Case Title: Delinquency, first installment and transfer-to-collection settings save
Objective / Description: [Financial Rules] Verify the Delinquency & First Installment and Installment Collection Schedule fields.
Requirement ID: Screen: Step 3 Financial Rules (UI-derived, no written AC); FR-UI-08
Preconditions:
1. User is logged in with permission to edit loan product configuration.
2. A loan product exists in draft with Step 1 General Information and Step 2 Loan Structure completed.
3. User opens /loan-product-config/edit/{productId} and selects Step 3 Financial Rules.
Test Steps:
1. Select each Delinquency Duration Mode, Delinquency Duration Unit, First Installment Status and First Installment Due option in turn and save.
2. Enter Transfer to Collection After = -1, 1.5, abc.

Test Case Title: Late Fee method and calculation options
Objective / Description: [Financial Rules] Verify Late Fee toggle, Fixed/Percentage method and the four calculation options including Formula.
Requirement ID: Screen: Step 3 Financial Rules (UI-derived, no written AC); FR-UI-09
Preconditions:
1. User is logged in with permission to edit loan product configuration.
2. A loan product exists in draft with Step 1 General Information and Step 2 Loan Structure completed.
3. User opens /loan-product-config/edit/{productId} and selects Step 3 Financial Rules.
Test Steps:
1. Turn Late Fee off and save.
2. Turn it on. Select Fixed, enter 50; then select Percentage, enter 2.
3. Select One Time, Incrementally (Daily), Incrementally (Monthly) in turn.
4. Select Formula and leave the formula empty, then enter a formula.
5. Save and reload.
Expected Result:
1. With the toggle off, Late Fee fields are hidden and not required.
2. The value input follows the selected method (amount vs %).
3. The formula input shows only when Formula is selected.
4. An empty or invalid formula is rejected (formula syntax per GAP-37).
5. Method, calculation option and value reload unchanged.

Test Case Title: Change banner, Discard and Submit for Review include Financial Rules
Objective / Description: [Financial Rules] Regression: verify the shared change banner and review actions count Step 3 changes.
Requirement ID: Screen: Step 3 Financial Rules (UI-derived, no written AC); FR-UI-13
Preconditions:
1. User is logged in with permission to edit loan product configuration.
2. A loan product exists in draft with Step 1 General Information and Step 2 Loan Structure completed.
3. User opens /loan-product-config/edit/{productId} and selects Step 3 Financial Rules.
4. The product has been submitted before (edit mode) and has no pending changes.
Test Steps:
1. Change Interest Rate and Fee #1 value and save.
2. Read the banner.
3. Click Discard changes.
4. Repeat step 1 and click Submit for Review.
Expected Result:
1. The banner shows '2 fields changed in Financial Rules - not yet submitted for review' and no stray separator (screen shows ', -', GAP-42).
2. Discard restores the last submitted Step 3 values and the banner disappears.
3. Submit for Review sends the changes; status per GAP-03.
Execution Readiness: Ready - needs a submitted (approved) product: EDIT_PRODUCT_ID with EDIT_PRODUCT_APPROVED=true

Test Case Title: Financial Rules limits enforced by the backend
Objective / Description: [Financial Rules] Verify that Step 3 rules are enforced by the API even when the UI is bypassed.
Requirement ID: Screen: Step 3 Financial Rules (UI-derived, no written AC); FR-UI-14; FE-267
Preconditions:
1. User is logged in with permission to edit loan product configuration.
2. A loan product exists in draft with Step 1 General Information and Step 2 Loan Structure completed.
3. User opens /loan-product-config/edit/{productId} and selects Step 3 Financial Rules.
4. User can send the Step 3 save request with an API client using the same session.
Test Steps:
1. Send the save request with Admin Percentage = 101.
2. Send Early Percentage = 8 and Early Settlement Available = 25.
3. Send an empty Disbursement Methods list.
4. Send Interest Rate = -1.
Expected Result:
1. Every request is rejected with a 4xx validation response naming the field.
2. Nothing is saved; reopening Step 3 shows the previous values.
